#!/usr/bin/python
import os, sqlite3
base = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
db = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(base, 'catalog.db'))
db.execute('UPDATE schema_version SET version=2')
db.commit()
db.execute('ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL')
db.commit()
db.close()

import sqlite3, sys
con = sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1])
print('SUCCESS version:', con.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_version').fetchall())
print('SUCCESS columns:', [(r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4]) for r in con.execute('PRAGMA table_info(products)')])
print('SUCCESS rows:', con.execute('SELECT id, description, price_cents FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall())

con.close()
